dependencies.independent: Read does not grant update. Update does not grant create or delete. The right to grant a permission does not grant the action.
dependencies.schema: The Constructor section opens with schema read. Record read alone does not open it. A record form uses the schema, but schema read is not turned on automatically.
dependencies.report: Build report needs both report read and generate. Either one does not include the other.
dependencies.task: The Create task shortcut needs both task read and task create.
dependencies.delegate: Managing assignments does not allow an arbitrary set. A role can receive only permissions from your delegation.
dependencies.roles: Assigning a ready role and editing its definition are different permissions. Managing assignments does not create or change a role. Read, create, update and delete do not include one another.
dependencies.users: Reading the user directory does not assign or remove roles and does not edit a role definition. Your own work permissions do not replace delegation.
dependencies.forms: The Forms section opens with forms read only. The draft needs update, and publishing is a separate right. Filling needs the published schema and record create. The record list and record view need record read. Deleting a form is a separate right and does not follow from update or publish. None of these rights includes its neighbor or opens the old constructor.
dependencies.table-views: The view list needs forms read and table-view read. The table and its rows also need record read. The published column catalog needs forms read. Create and update do not include read and do not open records. Preview needs create or update together with forms read and record read. Deleting a view does not delete the form or its records.
dependencies.sections: Section read opens only published sections and does not show the draft. Create does not include update. Update does not grant publish. Publish does not grant rights to the form, the view, or records. The work page with a table also requires form, table-view, and record read. The create-record button also requires record submit and the action enabled in the published configuration.
dependencies.organizations: Reading an organization does not allow editing it. Editing does not allow creating another and does not allow deleting it. Delete is not part of the organization administrator role. Organization create is checked against the corporation, not against a future organization id. Project create is checked against the organization, not against a future project id.
dependencies.personnel: Reading employees does not allow create, update, or archive. Archive and delete are different operations. Field setup and the account link do not follow from editing a card. A link does not create a login or assign a role.
dependencies.directories: Directory read allows selecting existing values. Editing records, archive, delete, and structure setup do not include one another. Deleting an unused record does not archive it and does not change cards.
dependencies.registries: Department and workplace rights are separate and do not follow from ordinary directory rights. Record view, create, update, archive and delete do not include one another. Attribute view, add, edit and delete are independent too. The system superadmin receives these actions from the system capability, not from a role title.
